observations: Black motorized height-adjustable desk with a glass or glossy black top.
Two large external monitors, one laptop, and a tablet are shown on the desk.
A control panel with buttons and a power indicator is visible on the left side of the desk.
The desk has a black footrest and a side-mounted bag holder.
The desk is shown at a height suitable for a standing workstation.
Watermarks 'ISRAEL AJALA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present on all photos.

claims.evidence: The control panel is visible, but there is no video showing the motor or the desk moving.
Weight cannot be determined from photos.
The photo shows the desk at one height, but its ability to adjust is not demonstrated.
The length is not explicitly stated in the photos.

risks.risk: The motor may be faulty or the desk may not raise/lower.
risks.proof: A video showing the desk being raised and lowered using the control panel.

risks.risk: The desk may be a generic brand with no brand name visible.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or the underside of the desk.

risks.risk: The glass top may have scratches or cracks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top surface.

risks.risk: The power cables and the control panel may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the control panel and the power cord.

proof_requests: Video of the desk being adjusted in height.
Photo of the brand name and model number on the manufacturer's label.
Close-up photos of the glass top to check for scratches.
Photo of the control panel and power cord.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
